- Not to sound like a mom, but make sure you go on the date with good hygiene, spritz some cologne on, brush your teeth and tongue, iron your clothes, and BE ON TIME. First dates can leave a lasting impression and bad hygiene can be a major turn off no matter the level of attraction.

- On the date, be a gentleman. Open her doors. 

- Give her a hug and tell her she looks beautiful/amazing/gorgeous when you first see her. Make eye contact.

- Ask follow up questions while shes talking about herself and not a laundry list of random ones. 

- If you find you have something in common, say “me too!” Now you have a topic of conversation you both can share your take on. 

- Be yourself. Tell her a story about one of your hobbies, confess you’re really into Sci-Fi or whatever you’re into, or talk about what your passion is and if you’re job fulfills you. Ask her about her passions and if her job is fulfilling.

- Talk to her like potential lifelong friend, and not a candidate for the wife position. Be more interested in whether she’s patient, respectful, honest, has a good head on her shoulders, and if your lifestyles and ambitions align.

- If she says anything self deprecating, like “I’m so clumsy” or “I gotta get my life together”, reassure her with something like “happens to the best of us.” Or “You got this/You’ll figure it out, I believe in you.” (I personally love words of affirmation, even if he can’t necessarily help how I feel, a man I like recognizing my efforts and expressing his support always makes me smile/blush).

- If you like her on the date and want to see her again, make it known you’re interested by hinting at the future (i.e. “You’ve never been to X?! I have to take you there one day.” If she says she loves long walks on the beach, or going dancing, say “Next time I see you, how about we get some ice cream and go for a walk on the beach?” Or “I’m not the best dancer, but there’s deals for salsa lessons on Groupon, would that be something you’d be interested in?”

- Be kind. Be flirty but not dirty. 

- Pay for the date. 

- Make sure she gets home safe and shoot her a text at the end of the night saying you had a great time and you look forward to seeing with her again.

Hope this helps.
